instruction: Finish the task with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `demo.ipc2581` plus the rule, padstack, and device sidecars are on the desktop. Export a board summary and production-readiness plan. Requirements: - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` with `component_count`, `net_count`, `via_count`, and `layer_count`. - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` with `fab_ready`, `blocking_violation_ids`, `min_clearance_mil`, `min_drill_mil`, and `assembly_variants`. - `fab_ready` is true only when the board has no error-severity violation. Preserve source order in both lists. [Software] The available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
